newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks extend losses to close down.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks extend losses to close down.

text.p: Madrid stocks extended earlier losses to close down in what dealers saw as a correction to Tuesday's historic highs and as bonds and other stock markets tumbled.
* General index was down 2.75 points, 0.73 percent, to 372.77.
* Telefonica slipped five pesetas to 2,490 in heavy trading.
"The fall in bonds encouraged selling in afternoon trading and in the short term the market looks volatile," said a trader at ABN-AMRO.

Turnover was again high on Wednesday, with trading reaching more than 49 billion pesetas. Telefonica and the electrical companies, which attracted considerable attention during Tuesday's rally, continued to be heavily traded.
Endesa closed down 70 pesetas, 0.88 percent, to 7,880. Iberdrola ended 15 pesetas down at 1,310.
Traders said they would remain cautious after Wednesday's losses and did not rule out the possibility of extended stock losses if bonds continued their downward spiral.
